properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real, address-tagged OpenStreetMap building footprint for Phase I of AvalonBay Communities' three-phase Mission Bay North rental complex (255 King St, ~250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) OSM way 945538326 gives only the address (255 King Street) and building=apartments; 'Phase I of a three-phase AvalonBay complex' is not stated by it or by the Arquitectonica page, and neither uses the name 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' (AvalonBay's own 2009 release calls the earlier phase 'Avalon at Mission Bay North'); the phase numbering is this repository's label. (2) '~250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica' is not supported as written: the Arquitectonica page describes a 407,000 SF LEED-certified development with 260 units, which matches the third phase, and gives no year; the DataSF Assessor roll (2023) for property location 255 King St (parcel 8706010) shows year built 2003, 256 units and 19 stories, and no source read names the architect of this building. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.'; notes: 'The building way used here is the actual footprint; a companion OSM landuse way (867565682) may cover the same site but was not checked. That this is the 'first of three AvalonBay phases along King St' is not stated by any cited source: the name and numbering 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' are this repository's label, since OSM way 945538326 has no name and Arquitectonica titles its page 'Avalon Mission Bay'.'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8706010 (5,640 m2, active, mapped 2004-04-26); the earlier outline of 4,971 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.84 (97% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 86% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 253 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lots 8706010 and 8706011 and 251 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'OpenStreetMap (way 945538326, 255 King St)'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be mapped from one parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.'. Previous notes: 'The building way used here is the actual footprint; a companion OSM landuse way (867565682) may cover the same site but was not checked. That this is the 'first of three AvalonBay phases along King St' is not stated by any cited source: the name and numbering 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' are Pier & Point's own label, since OSM way 945538326 has no name and Arquitectonica titles its page 'Avalon Mission Bay'.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8706010 (5,640 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 253 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lots 8706010 and 8706011 and 251 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 945538326, 255 King St)); 97% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 86% of the lot.
properties.notes: That this is the 'first of three AvalonBay phases along King St' is not stated by any cited source: the name and numbering 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' are Pier & Point's own label, since OSM way 945538326 has no name and Arquitectonica titles its page 'Avalon Mission Bay'.
